observations.detail: Each platform generated and validated its release-manifest.json before the packaged-runtime audit.
Each platform's unpacked artifact contained the Electron runtime license asset and the audit confirmed Electron attribution.
Each platform's unpacked artifact contained the Chromium notice asset and the audit confirmed Chromium and Node.js attribution.
Each platform contained a non-empty app.asar paired with its runtime notice assets.

limitations: This proves the new automated packaged-runtime gate on preview artifacts; final transitive package attribution, signing/notarization, publication and offline installation remain separate release gates.
